newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - MBNA Corp Q2 net rises.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - MBNA Corp Q2 net rises.

text.p: (dollars in thousand, expect per share amounts)
For the Three Months For the Six Months

NOTES: The company said net income for six-months 1996 include a $32.8 million tax benefit related to amortization of intangible assets acquired in connection with the 1991 initial public offering, and a charge of $32.8 million ($54.3 million pretax) related to the launch of its MBNA Platinum Plus MasterCard and Visa program.

Per share data and shares outstanding have been restated to reflect the three-for-two split of its common stock, effected in the form of a dividend, issued January 1, 1997, to stockholders of record as of December 16, 1996.

The company said per share results have not been restated to reflect the three-for-two split of its common stock, which will be effected in the form of a dividend, to be issued October 1, 1997, to stockholders of record as of September 15, 1997.
